entities.justification: Named at the beginning of the testimony regarding his genealogy: 'Stephanus Skrzynski praestito prius super Sacra de veritate dicenda corporali iuramento testimonium genealogiae'.
Named as the first witness testifying on the genealogy: 'Primus testis Thomas Zegrzyr habens annos Nonaginta circa vel ultra Ciuis Skrzyniensis'.
Town mentioned via the citizenship of Thomas Zegrzyr: 'Ciuis Skrzyniensis'.
Named as the second witness: 'Secundus testis Famatus Mathias Zostrowicz maiens Annos Octaginta circa vel ultra deposuit'.
Named as the fourth witness: 'Quartus testis Laboriosus Mathias Ciesot de Villa Kozlowicze Subditus'.
Village from which Mathias Ciesot originates: 'de Villa Kozlowicze'.
